run_cg_solve: run the conjugate gradient solver to solve a linear system Ax=b using a matrix-vector product function
test_cg_solve: test the cg_solve function with a known matrix-vector product and verify the solution converges within tolerance
create_cg_solve_wrapper: create a wrapper function around cg_solve that accepts a numpy matrix A instead of a matrix-vector product function
refactor_cg_solve: refactor the cg_solve function to support an initial guess x_0 instead of always starting from zero
summarize_cg_solve: summarize the cg_solve conjugate gradient solver implementation and its parameters for documentation purposes
